_: checks source_sha256 and ast_sha256, so editing the fixture without re-exporting fails.
/opt/joern ships only c2cpg. gosrc2cpg 4.0.606 was assembled from Maven Central
(io.joern:gosrc2cpg_3:4.0.606, runtime scope, org.gradle:gradle-tooling-api excluded) and run
with the jars /opt/joern-mvn/lib lacks on that classpath. gosrc2cpg shells out to `goastgen`:
found on PATH, and also at ./bin/astgen/goastgen-linux of the working directory.
Only cases.go (plus a go.mod, `module fx`) is parsed; main.go is the oracle driver and is
not exported (it uses defer/recover, which Core does not model).
Oracle: go1.24.7 linux/amd64 (`go build cases.go main.go`).
frontend: gosrc2cpg 4.0.606 (io.joern.gosrc2cpg.Main) with goastgen v0.1.0, default options
command: java -cp '/opt/joern-mvn/lib/*:<the gosrc2cpg_3 runtime jars>/*' io.joern.gosrc2cpg.Main <a directory holding only cases.go and go.mod> --output cpg.bin
